description: Grid editor for a table block's cells. Lets the user edit each cell's text inline, mark rows (or just the first row) as header rows, and add or remove rows and columns. The grid lives in a horizontal scroll container with a pinned control column, labels every cell for assistive technology, and each cell opens the full cell dialog (text, link, spans, alignment, background).

parameters.name: Block
parameters.description: The table block being edited (mutated in place).

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Renders the grid read-only: the native controls are disabled and every mutating method returns early, so a host that emulates a cell edit (bUnit, a synthetic event) cannot change the document.
